message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) |
|------------|------------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (5 g) |
| Baking powder | 1 tsp (5 g) |
| Salt | ½ tsp (2.5 g) |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp (10 ml) |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras**  
- 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk or yogurt (replaces milk for extra moisture)  
- ½ cup (120 ml) brewed coffee (enhances chocolate flavor)  

These amounts give you a moist, fluffy chocolate cake that’s perfect for frosting or serving plain. Happy baking!
